mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTITEP P1 WHERE P1.PAY_DAY IS NOT NULL AND P1.PAY_DAY >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND P1.PAY_DAY < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS CURR_PAY_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTITEP P2 WHERE P2.PAY_DAY IS NOT NULL AND P2.PAY_DAY >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND P2.PAY_DAY < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') ), 0) AS PREV_PAY_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(P3.PAY, 0)) FROM ARTITEP P3 WHERE P3.PAY_DAY IS NOT NULL AND P3.PAY_DAY >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND P3.PAY_DAY < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS CURR_PAY_AMT, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(COALESCE(P4.PAY, 0)) FROM ARTITEP P4 WHERE P4.PAY_DAY IS NOT NULL AND P4.PAY_DAY >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND P4.PAY_DAY < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') ), 0) AS PREV_PAY_AMT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTITED D1 WHERE D1.PAY_STA = '01' AND D1.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND D1.REQ_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND D1.REQ_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS CURR_UNPAID_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ARTITED D2 WHERE D2.PAY_STA = '01' AND D2.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND D2.REQ_DATE >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND D2.REQ_DATE < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') ), 0) AS PREV_UNPAID_CNT, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(D3.WATER_COST, 0) - COALESCE(D3.WATER_PAY, 0), 0)) FROM ARTITED D3 WHERE D3.PAY_STA = '01' AND D3.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND D3.REQ_DATE >= STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AND D3.REQ_DATE < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) ), 0) AS CURR_UNPAID_AMT, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(D4.WATER_COST, 0) - COALESCE(D4.WATER_PAY, 0), 0)) FROM ARTITED D4 WHERE D4.PAY_STA = '01' AND D4.REQ_DATE IS NOT NULL AND D4.REQ_DATE >= DATE_SUB(STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AND D4.REQ_DATE < STR_TO_DATE(CONCAT(#{baseMonth}, '-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') ), 0) AS PREV_UNPAID_AMT
